1 Hacker Way

[Date]

To the Meta Board of Directors and the Meta Community,  

I am writing to formally resign from my position as CEO and co-founder of Meta Platforms, Inc., effective immediately. After 20 years of building what started as a dorm-room project into a global force connecting billions, I believe it's time for new leadership to chance the next era of innovation. We've achieved extraordinary milestones—scaling Facebook to over 3 billion users, launching Instagram and WhatsApp, and pioneering the metaverse—but the path ahead demands fresh perspectives unburdened by my history.  

This decision comes after deep reflection on our company's impact. We've connected families across continents, empowered creators through Reels and Horizon Worlds, and advanced AI with Llama models that rival the best in the world. Yet, challenges like regulatory scrutiny, privacy debates, and the relentless pace of AI development have highlighted the need for evolution. I remain bullish on Meta's mission to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together, but I no longer see myself as the right person to lead it forward. Stepping aside allows the board to appoint a successor who can navigate these waters with renewed energy.  

To my incredible team: Thank you for the countless late nights, bold bets, and unbreakable spirit. You've turned ideas into reality—from AR glasses to neural interfaces—that will shape humanity's future. I plan to stay involved as a board advisor initially, offering guidance on long-term vision, but I'll root for you from the outside. Priscilla and I will continue our philanthropy through the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, focusing on curing diseases and reforming education.  

Please accept this letter as my official notice. I wish Meta boundless success and am grateful for the journey.  

Sincerely,  
Mark Zuckerberg
